messages:
Aisha: Hi finance — CatalystML (pilot, EU) asked for a 30% pilot discount for 3 months and NET90 invoicing. They want an upfront SKU credit and a clause to convert to committed Dedicated at negotiated rate after pilot. Can we approve? Details: expected pilot run ~250M tokens (~$6k/mo list). Contract starts 2026-04-05. @Lena can you weigh in on pricing guardrails?

Tom: What's the expected ARR if they convert? Also need GL code and whether legal needs special T&Cs. NET90 is risky for a small pilot — prefer NET45. Can we do a milestone payment instead?

Lena: We can do an exception for pilots but limit to 25% standard discount + one-time onboarding credit. Approvals: finance + CFO signoff for >25%. Need usage cap and auto-fallback to list pricing after 90 days. @deal-desk-bot, can you generate an approval ticket?

deal-desk-bot: Approval ticket created: DD-2026-4837. Link: https://redwood.internal/dd/DD-2026-4837. Required approvers: Finance (Tom), CFO-Jen. Attach contract template: /files/pilot-pricing-exception-v2.docx

Miguel: Sales asks to keep NET90 — client procurement insists. If we push NET45 we lose the deal. They are a strategic ML infra partner. Any compromise?

Tom: If procurement insists on NET90, require a 10% bank guarantee or ACH + credit card on file. Also 30% discount only if we get signed LOI with conversion clause. Otherwise cap at 20%.

Aisha: Customer can do LOI. They're ok with conversion clause. They also requested a 3-month ramp: 30% month1, 20% month2, 10% month3 — can we map that to billing credits instead of reducing unit price?

Lena: Prefer credits. Approve tiered credit schedule: month1 25% credit, month2 15%, month3 10% credit. This avoids creating custom SKUs. CFO-Jen to sign off on NET90.

CFO-Jen: I'll approve NET90 only if finance signs escrow plan and we include early-conversion payment triggers. Approve up to 25% combined pilot discount/credit. Send final docs to me for e-sign.

Aisha: Great — action items: (1) Tom opens GL/escrow plan (2) Lena drafts amendment with credit schedule and conversion triggers (3) Miguel gets LOI signed. I'll attach projected usage and token calc. Thanks :thumbsup:

Tom: Opening ticket for GL + escrow: FIN-2026-991. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Miguel: LOI emailed to client, awaiting signature. Will ping when signed.

Lena: Drafted amendment and uploaded: /files/DD-2026-4837-amendment-v1.pdf. Please review.

Aisha: Marking thread resolved for now. Will follow up when LOI or CFO sign completes. :white_check_mark:
